about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes: the countries a standard's applies_in and an organisation's operates_in may name (schemas/standard, applies_in). Their ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes are in iso-3166-2.json beside this file. Codes only.

source.publisher: IANA, the Language Subtag Registry of BCP 47 (RFC 5646), whose region subtags carry every assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code as the ISO 3166 Maintenance Agency publishes it
source.license: public domain: IANA and the IETF Trust dedicate the protocol registries to the public domain under the terms of CC0 1.0 (joint statement of 10 November 2021, https://www.iana.org/help/licensing-terms)
source.method: Every record of Type region whose Subtag is two letters, with no Deprecated field and a Description other than 'Private use', less the ISO 3166-1 codes exceptionally reserved (listed under excluded), which the registry carries as subtags but ISO does not assign to a country. Cross-checked against the UN Statistics Division's M49 overview (https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/overview/), retrieved the same day: its 248 ISO-alpha2 codes are all here, and the one code here it does not list is TW, which M49 does not carry as a separate area.
source.why_not_iso: ISO publishes ISO 3166 through its Online Browsing Platform, whose terms forbid scraping and automated extraction, and sells the machine-readable files; it publishes no free machine-readable copy. The IANA registry is public domain and is kept in step with the ISO 3166 Maintenance Agency, and this list names the registry's File-Date so that a newer ISO change is a visible update, never a silent difference.

exceptionally_reserved.EU: the European Union, as schemas/standard allows in applies_in
